# dsh-freeweb
**A keyless web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness.**

The model calls the `web_search` tool with a query; the plugin runs two search
engines concurrently,

merges their results into one list, removes duplicates,
and shortens snippets by rank. If an engine

fails, the next one in the order
takes its place. No API key or account is required, and the defaul

t
configuration needs no changes.

## Which engines

Exa and Keenable run first. degoog, Startpage, DuckDuckGo and AnySearch are
fallbacks and take over

when one fails. All six are keyless; optional keys only
raise rate limits.
